speed_method: The playback speed is applied to the entire source timeline before any clip is selected: every frame time is divided by the speed factor and clips are chosen as exact 3-second windows on this sped-up timeline (3.9 s of original footage each). Each selected window is then rendered from the original file with the speed change applied exactly once (video setpts=PTS/1.3, audio atempo=1.3). No intermediate sped-up copy is encoded, which avoids an extra generation of quality loss; the result is identical to cutting the windows from a fully sped-up copy.
